BiblicalUsage: Machshak is darkness, the dark place, and it is where people hide and where God finds them. Isaiah 42:16 promises God will make darkness light before the blind, and Lamentations 3:6 has the sufferer set in dark places, as they that be dead of old. Psalms 74:20 says the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe this word is honest about darkness: it is real, it is where cruelty lives, and it is not beyond God's reach. My position is that Isaiah 42:16 is the promise that holds the other two verses together, because the God who leads the blind out of darkness does not leave His people in it.
